## Line 109

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/solids-csg.library.plato, line 109](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/solids-csg.library.plato#L109).

```plato

    // The vertices edge (a -> b) contributes to the ring clipped to the plane's
    // front half-space: a itself when a is on or in front of the plane, then
    // the crossing point when the edge changes sides.
    ClipEdge(pl: Plane, a: Point3D, b: Point3D): Array<Point3D>
        => KeepPoint(pl.SignedDistance(a) >= 0.0, a)
            .Concatenate(KeepPoint(
                (pl.SignedDistance(a) >= 0.0).ExclusiveOr(pl.SignedDistance(b) >= 0.0),
                pl.CrossingPoint(a, b)));
```
